chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from al-Abbas, from Safwan ibn Yahya, who said:

Abu Harith asked him about a man who performed the Tamattu' (combining Umrah and Hajj) who performed Tawaf and Sa'i and shortened his prayer; is there upon him the Tawaf al-Nisa' (Women's Tawaf)? He said: 'No, rather the Tawaf al-Nisa' is after returning from Mina.'

key_terms.طَوَافُ النِّسَاءِ: Tawaf al-Nisa' (Women's Tawaf / Tawaf of the non-residents)

ai.seo_question: When should a person performing Tamattu' Hajj perform Tawaf al-Nisa?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, the Imam clarifies the timing of Tawaf al-Nisa' for those performing Tamattu' Hajj, specifying that it is deferred until after the return from Mina rather than performed immediately after the initial rites. This ruling highlights the distinct procedural sequence of Tamattu' compared to Qiran or Ifrad, emphasizing the pilgrim's temporary status and the specific obligations tied to the Hajj days. The clarification underscores the precision of Shia fiqh in distinguishing between obligatory acts based on the type of Hajj and the pilgrim's residency status.
